name: W3C DTCG Tokenized Design Engine
diagnostic: Are our core visual brand assets stored in static mockups, or are they declared as platform-agnostic, version-controlled JSON tokens?
artifact: A validated, multi-tier `tokens.json` schema separating primitive values from semantic aliases using standardized `$value`, `$type`, and `$description` properties.
trap: Treating design tokens merely as a color variable list rather than an integrated typographic, spatial, and semantic decision engine.
pedigreeFull: W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG Format Module, stable specification 2025.10).
